mapper.select: SELECT USER_PASSWORD_HASH FROM `USER` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL AS buttieLevel, CASE COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') WHEN 'STABLE' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_STABLE WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_CAUTION WHEN 'DANGER' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_DANGER END AS buttieImageUrl, u.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, u.USER_NAME AS userName, ep.BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, u.USER_PHONE_NUMBER AS userPhoneNumber, u.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail FROM USER u JOIN USER_BUTTIE ub ON u.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = bl.LEVEL JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT s ON ub.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET USER_NICKNAME = #{user.userNickname}, USER_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{user.userId}
mapper.select: SELECT ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL AS buttieLevel, bl.STAGE_NAME AS stageName, bl.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION AS levelDescription, ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP AS buttieTotalExp, bl.REQUIRED_EXP AS requiredExp, COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') AS riskLevel, CASE COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') WHEN 'STABLE' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_STABLE WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_CAUTION WHEN 'DANGER' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_DANGER END AS buttieImageUrl FROM USER_BUTTIE ub JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = bl.LEVEL LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT s ON ub.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND s.SNAPSHOT_BASE_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(s2.SNAPSHOT_BASE_DATE) FROM SNAPSHOT s2 WHERE s2.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID ) WHERE ub.USER_ID = #{userId}
